about_the_game: Elijah Reed, a seasoned agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, is no stranger to pulse-pounding missions and high-stakes challenges. So when he's dispatched to the quiet Norwegian town of Bergen, he's ready for monsters, mythical creatures, and ancient magic. But what do you pack when you're tasked with saving the world from certain doom? What gift do you bring to a mighty Valkyrie and a magical squirrel? And, most pressing of all, does the Ministry's expense account cover inter-dimensional travel through the realms of Yggdrasil?
